title: The Hound at the Turnstile
subtitle: Encounter · Encounter seed · opposition with several solutions

fields.label: Situation
fields.value: The Margin Hound blocks the maintenance turnstile beneath the tower. Behind it, a witness cylinder is being carried toward the engine.

fields.label: Telegraph
fields.value: Its paper ribs rustle toward the party's signed documents, not their weapons. A discarded forgiven debt lies untouched beside its paw.

fields.label: Options
fields.value: Sneak past its Notice +2; distract it with another genuinely broken signed promise; obtain a lawful Office transfer; ask a creditor to forgive the scent-bearing debt; or confront it directly.

fields.label: If it becomes a fight
fields.value: Use the creature's sheet: Fight +3, appropriate other skills, stress and mild slot. No assumed party-size balance. It attacks to seize the contract and yields when its binding is lawfully lifted.

fields.label: Noncombat stakes
fields.value: Failing an opposed bypass may expose the witness, consume time or create a new obstacle. Agree the meaningful cost instead of making every failed roll inflict damage.

fields.label: Connection
fields.value: The encounter changes access to the finale, not the truth of the forgery. A party that withdraws can still pursue an audit or reach the engine by another route.
